name: doomsday_brainstorm_led_kill
comment: Same-turn Doomsday kill via Brainstorm + LED: pile [Wraith, Edge, LED, Oracle, filler]; Brainstorm lifts the top three and puts back two junk Islands; LED resolves before the cycle chain; the Edge cycle's draw is the crack window (sac LED for UUU with Oracle still in the library), then Oracle wins off the floating mana on turn 1. The in-hand Street Wraith is load-bearing: Brainstorm's two put-backs cost two draws, so a pile-only chain is always one draw short.
